category_descriptions.Clinical and EHR-based datasets: Studies using patient-level clinical data such as electronic health records, clinical notes, hospital registries, imaging records, federated health data, or other real-world healthcare datasets.
category_descriptions.Biomedical literature and knowledge reso: Studies using biomedical publications, abstracts, full-text articles, textbooks, ontologies, databases, or other structured knowledge sources such as PubMed, PMC, UMLS, GO, HPO, or DrugBank.
category_descriptions.Benchmark, QA, and task-specific evaluat: Studies centered on established benchmarks or evaluation corpora for prediction, question answering, information extraction, classification, retrieval, or multimodal biomedical tasks.
category_descriptions.Synthetic, expert-created, or instructio: Studies using manually created scenarios, expert-authored questions, synthetic examples, simplified texts, or curated instruction datasets for training or evaluating models.
category_descriptions.Reviews, editorials, and non-dataset syn: Papers that primarily summarize prior work, provide editorial overviews, or conduct literature reviews without introducing a single primary experimental dataset.
